replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Honestly, I've always found maths intimidating. It feels cold and rigid compared to philosophy or literature, which I love. My parents' limited education didn't help; they struggled too. I prefer creative thinking over strict formulas.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. The pressure of getting it right makes me nervous. I worry about failing or looking stupid in front of others. It's a real source of stress for me.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor once. It felt helpful at first, but I found it too impersonal. Sometimes it gave answers without explaining the 'why', which made me feel more confused than before.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA involves standardizing your data, then finding eigenvectors of the covariance matrix to identify directions of maximum variance. You don't need to panic; just focus on understanding the concept rather than memorizing complex formulas.
